question: Which isolated faction-mechanic changes compress the observed Demis, Elon, Sam, and Jensen faction extremes without creating a new faction or strategy dominance?

selectionRule.imperialCandidate: Prefer the lifetime cap only if it compresses Demis across player counts without making the faction low at five or six.
selectionRule.verticalCandidate: Prefer the broader discount only if it improves Elon beyond the Compute-only probe without creating a leading faction cell.
selectionRule.coalitionCandidate: Prefer 7 starting Runway only if it improves Sam at three through six players without creating a two-player lead.
selectionRule.foundryCandidate: Prefer one Shovels trigger per round only if it reduces Jensen's high-count lead while preserving competitiveness at two through four.
selectionRule.independence: Each candidate is compared only with canonical on common seeds. Any selected combination requires a separate confirmation.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: The probe cannot establish human negotiation quality, perceived faction identity, duration, fairness, or fun.
